Messages.Author: SirTemple
Messages.Body:
Does camerilla vitae slave increase a discapline immediately, or does it only
work after it's been in play for a turn, i.e. it's first master phase in play?

Jason

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
SirTemple wrote:
>
> Does camerilla vitae slave increase a discapline immediately, or does it only
> work after it's been in play for a turn, i.e. it's first master phase in play?

The Camarilla Vitae Slave increases its employer's capacity
Immediately (card text). The employer only gets a new discipline
during his controller's Master Phase (card text).
